item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.27

  • Clipboard history, rebuilt: see it as a list with a preview or as cards, search it, narrow it to text, links, pictures or files, and pin what you use most. Pins stay after quitting.
  • Each new copy shows as “Copied” beside the closed notch for a moment; open the notch then and it goes straight to the clipboard.
  • Open a copied picture full size in the notch: pinch or scroll to zoom, drag its edges to resize it, and lock it open while you work beside it.
  • Lighter and quicker: with a song playing, the open notch uses about a tenth of the CPU it did, and buttons and the menu answer the pointer at once.
  • Settings → General can hide the menu bar icon (right-click the notch for Settings), and Help has a tidier look.
